name: remnote-sakura-theme
description: Cherry blossom theme for RemNote. Branches behind a translucent interface, with optional falling petals.

scripts.clean: shx rm -rf build dist *.zip src/lib/assets.generated.ts src/lib/css.generated.ts
scripts.dev: npm run sources && cross-env NODE_ENV=development webpack serve --color --progress
scripts.dev:lan: npm run sources && cross-env NODE_ENV=development HOST=0.0.0.0 webpack serve --color --progress
scripts.build:theme: npm run sources && node scripts/build-theme.mjs && shx rm -f SakuraTheme.zip && bestzip SakuraTheme.zip theme.css manifest.json README.md logo.png
scripts.build:plugin: npm run sources && npx remnote-plugin validate && shx rm -rf dist && shx rm -f SakuraPlugin.zip && cross-env NODE_ENV=production webpack --color && shx cp README.md dist && cd dist && bestzip ../SakuraPlugin.zip ./*
scripts.build: npm run build:theme && npm run build:plugin
